closed_since: 2023-04-30 — final day of trading at 神田神保町3-1-19; a move was talked about at the time but no successor shop has opened anywhere in the three years since
name: 神保町 黒須
address_ja: 東京都千代田区神田神保町3-1-19
cuisine: For six and a half years the most decorated shōyu-ramen counter in Jimbōchō — seven seats down an alley between the Jōnan Shinkin bank and the Shūeisha building, a Michelin Bib Gourmand three years running and a Tabelog Ramen Hyakumeiten pick four years running, with the 味玉塩蕎麦 at ¥1,300 the bowl reviewers named. It closed on 30 April 2023.
neighborhood: Kanda-Jimbōchō 3-chōme — 296 m and 2 minutes from Jimbōchō (Toei Shinjuku and Tokyo Metro Hanzōmon lines), 5 minutes from Jimbōchō on the Toei Mita line, 4 minutes from Kudanshita (Toei Shinjuku/Hanzōmon) and 5 from Kudanshita on the Tōzai line. It sat at the end of a narrow alley in the gap between the Jōnan Shinkin Bank and the Shūeisha building.
hours_raw: [月～土] 10:30～15:00　定休日：日曜日（祝日不定休、SNSをご参照下さい） — these were the hours until the 30 April 2023 closure.
gf_detail: Academic now, and it would have been 'no' regardless: the shop's whole reputation rested on a shōyu bowl — 醤油蕎麦 and 塩蕎麦 — built on wheat soy sauce and served with wheat ramen noodles from a single boiler on a seven-seat counter. No allergen information or gluten-free claim was ever published.
vegan_detail: No plant-based option existed. A single-bowl ramen counter with chāshū and an ajitama as its signature garnishes; nothing vegetable-only was ever on the menu.

chef_bio.chef_name: 黒須 (Kurosu) — the Instagram account for the shop, @jinbouchou_kurosu, carries the display name 黒須太一, so the given name is probably Taichi; no source found states it in running text, so treat the surname as certain and the given name as probable
chef_bio.background: 神保町 黒須 opened on 1 November 2016 in a seven-seat, counter-only room reached down a narrow alley between the Jōnan Shinkin Bank and the Shūeisha building — Tabelog files it under 隠れ家レストラン and 一軒家レストラン, which for once is literal. Its owner had come to public notice as one of the last two contestants in the ramen edition of 有吉ジャポン's 成り上がりジャポン before opening here. What followed was one of the fastest reputations in Tokyo ramen: Michelin Bib Gourmand in 2021, 2022 and 2023, and selection as a Tabelog Ramen TOKYO Hyakumeiten in 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2022 — four consecutive years — finishing at 3.90 over 1,918 reviews with 58,000 saves. The bowls reviewers wrote about were the 醤油蕎麦 and the 塩蕎麦, the latter with an ajitama at ¥1,300. It served mornings only, 10:30 to 15:00, six days a week, cash only, all non-smoking, seven seats, no cards of any kind. It shut on 30 April 2023. Reviewers who went on the last day recorded it as a relocation rather than an ending — 「移転の…」 — and one who returned on 1 May found the shop stripped with no notice on the door and the fittings passed to a restaurant-transfer company. Three years on, no shop under this name or this owner appears anywhere on Tabelog, the old domain jinbochoukurosu.net answers with an empty body, and the closure has to be treated as permanent.
chef_bio.specialty: 醤油蕎麦 and 味玉塩蕎麦 (¥1,300) — clear, precise shōyu and shio bowls, the ones every Hyakumeiten citation named.

anecdotes.text: A regular reviewer summed the record up on the final day: 「2016年11月創業後、ミシュラン東京に３年連続選出！食べログのラーメン百名店に４年連続選出の行列店『神保町 黒須』が 2023年4月30日をもって閉店します！」
Another went back the morning after: 「5月1日午前中に店舗跡に足を運ぶ。閉店告知はないが全てが終わった後との雰囲気が漂い、もの寂しい気持ちとなる。」 There was no closing notice on the door at all.
Finding it was part of the experience — Tabelog's own directions read 「城南信用金庫と集英社のビルの隙間にある狭い路地の奥にある」.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13201888 is headed 【閉店】神保町 黒須 and states 「このお店は現在閉店しております」. It gives 東京都千代田区神田神保町3-1-19, coordinates 35.69551/139.75489, genre ラーメン, 296 m from Jimbōchō station with the alley directions, hours 10:30–15:00 Monday to Saturday closed Sundays, 7 counter seats, cash only with no cards or electronic money, all non-smoking, takeaway, an opening date of 2016年11月1日, a rating of 3.90 across 1,918 reviews, the award list (ラーメン百名店 / 食べログ ラーメン TOKYO 百名店 for 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2022), the homepage jinbochoukurosu.net, official accounts x.com/jimbouchoukuros and instagram.com/jinbouthoukurosu, and the note 「『有吉ジャポン』の『成り上がりジャポン ラーメン編』で最終選考の２人まで残った黒須店主が神保町に開業した店」. Three of its most-read reviews are closure reports dated April and May 2023, one titled 【本日閉店】東京で最も印象的なラーメン店, another 「そして、神保町のレジェンドに！」, and a 2023/09 review recording 味玉塩蕎麦¥1300, Tabelog 3.89, ミシュランビブグルマン2021〜2023 and 食べログラーメンTOKYO百名店2019〜2022.

gf_cross_contamination.text: A seven-seat counter with one noodle boiler serving nothing but wheat ramen; no separate preparation was ever claimed.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The shop's identity was its 醤油蕎麦 — a wheat-soy-sauce bowl. No tamari or gluten-free seasoning was ever mentioned.

cultural_comfort.note: Do not send anyone down the alley off Hakusan-dōri looking for this. 神保町 黒須 served its last bowl on 30 April 2023 after six and a half years, three Michelin Bib Gourmands and four consecutive Tabelog Hyakumeiten selections. A relocation was discussed at the time and never happened: as of August 2026 no restaurant under this name or this owner is registered anywhere on Tabelog, a nationwide keyword search for 中華蕎麦 黒須 returns no successor, and the shop's old domain jinbochoukurosu.net now returns an empty page. The record should be hidden from the app. If the owner does reopen, the Instagram account @jinbouchou_kurosu is the place it would be announced.

enrich_note: Confirmed as a real Jimbōchō shop and confirmed permanently closed — this one needed care, because a plain Tabelog keyword search hides it. A nationwide search for 黒須 (HTTP 200, 699件) returns tofu shops, confectioners and convenience stores in Chiba, Saitama and Tochigi and no ramen shop at all, and a search for 神保町 黒須 (HTTP 200, 84件) returns unrelated Tokyo restaurants — the kind of result that would have been written up as NOT FOUND. A Yahoo Japan search for 神保町 黒須 ラーメン (HTTP 200) resolved it immediately: the top hit is Tabelog 13201888, already titled 【閉店】神保町 黒須, at 東京都千代田区神田神保町3-1-19, genre ラーメン, matching the light record's 千代田区神田神保町・神保町駅 and 醤油ラーメン exactly. Closure date 30 April 2023 comes from the shop's own Tabelog page plus three dated reviewer reports, one written on the final day and one from the morning after. I then checked specifically for a relocation, because the last-day reviewer mentions 移転: the shop's site jinbochoukurosu.net returns HTTP 200 with a zero-length body, a nationwide Tabelog search for 中華蕎麦 黒須 (HTTP 200, 136件) shows no successor, and Yahoo Japan searches for 黒須 移転 / 再開 (HTTP 200 both) returned only 2023 closure coverage. On that evidence status is closed_permanently rather than temporary. Coordinates updated to Tabelog's (35.695511, 139.754891), about 200 m from the sweep's approximate pin.
